onset.Description: Event onset in seconds relative to the beginning of the EEG recording.

duration.Description: Event duration in seconds. Zero indicates an instantaneous event marker.

sample.Description: Event sample index in the EEG recording, rounded from EEGLAB event latency.

trial_type.Description: Semantic event label decoded from the working-memory EEG event marker. The participant response event marks when a mouse response was registered; the reported colour value itself is stored in the behavioural TSV file, not in this events file.

Levels.memory_array_onset: Onset of the memory array containing the target and non-target colours.
Levels.retention_interval_onset: Onset of the retention interval following the memory array.
Levels.response_screen_onset: Onset of the response screen containing the colour wheel/probe display.
Levels.participant_response: Participant response event indicating that a colour report was registered.
Levels.parallel_port_reset: Parallel-port reset marker. This is not a task event.
Levels.eeglab_boundary: EEGLAB boundary marker indicating a recording boundary or discontinuity.
Levels.unknown_event: Unclassified event marker retained from the original EEG event structure.

value.Description: Canonical text representation of the original EEG.event.type marker. Standard planned task markers encode set size and event phase: set_size*10+1 = memory-array onset; set_size*10+2 = retention onset; set_size*10+3 = response-screen onset; set_size*10 = participant response. Non-standard raw markers observed in the EEG event stream are retained.

Levels.208: Non-standard raw marker observed in the EEG event stream; interpreted as set-size 2 participant response event based on sequence position.
Levels.238: Non-standard raw marker observed in the EEG event stream; interpreted as set-size 2 response-screen onset based on sequence position.
Levels.408: Non-standard raw marker observed in the EEG event stream; interpreted as set-size 4 participant response event based on sequence position.
Levels.438: Non-standard raw marker observed in the EEG event stream; interpreted as set-size 4 response-screen onset based on sequence position.
Levels.608: Non-standard raw marker observed in the EEG event stream; interpreted as set-size 6 participant response event based on sequence position.
Levels.638: Non-standard raw marker observed in the EEG event stream; interpreted as set-size 6 response-screen onset based on sequence position.
Levels.boundary: EEGLAB boundary marker indicating a recording boundary or discontinuity.
Levels.1278: Non-standard raw marker observed in the EEG event stream. This marker was retained from the original event structure but is not part of the planned working-memory task trigger scheme.
Levels.228: Non-standard raw marker observed in the EEG event stream. This marker was retained from the original event structure but is not part of the planned working-memory task trigger scheme.
Levels.428: Non-standard raw marker observed in the EEG event stream. This marker was retained from the original event structure but is not part of the planned working-memory task trigger scheme.
Levels.628: Non-standard raw marker observed in the EEG event stream. This marker was retained from the original event structure but is not part of the planned working-memory task trigger scheme.

set_size.Description: Working-memory set size encoded by the event marker, where applicable.

Levels.n/a: Not applicable to this event marker.

marker_status.Description: Whether the event marker corresponds to a planned task trigger, a non-standard raw marker, or an EEGLAB/non-task marker.

Levels.planned_task_marker: Marker generated by the planned working-memory task trigger scheme.
Levels.nonstandard_raw_marker: Non-standard raw marker observed in the EEG event stream and interpreted from sequence position where possible.
Levels.unknown_raw_marker: Raw marker could not be classified from the task event scheme.
